subject: Re: evening access question
text: Hi there, Thanks for the office note two days ago. Sorry I missed replying. I looked through what you sent, but I'm still unclear on a few parts. Does the service start on the first business day of the month, or does it depend on when the paperwork is received? I ask because our block party committee is trying to schedule the signup table, and if the date is flexible it might be easier to put it after the school fair. Also, I noticed you mentioned a support phone line. Are calls answered until late, and is there a separate number for weekend help? I may have read the pamphlet from last spring, not the one. There was a line about temporary access for visitors; does that still apply if someone only comes once? Could you point me to the page that lists current fees and exact hours? I want to avoid telling anyone something out of date, especially since our neighbor group expects details. If it is easier, a short bullet answer would help. Also, if the application needs proof of address, what formats are accepted? I also wonder whether the service includes online account setup or if that is a separate visit. Someone asked if seniors can use the counter without an appointment, but I do not want to promise anything. I might print the flyer if you share a stable link for the meeting please and thank you. I will pass it along once you send it.
